readme_excerpt:
# 中小学·高中知识图谱（数学 + 语文 + 英语 + 物理）

对齐《义务教育数学课程标准（2022 年版 2025 年修订）》（教育部《中小学课程方案和课程标准日常修订版》，教材〔2025〕1 号）、《普通高中数学课程标准（2017年版2025年修订）》的**必修和选择性必修**，以及《义务教育英语课程标准（2022年版）》一级、二级和三级（7–9 年级）和《普通高中英语课程标准（2017年版2025年修订）》的必修、选择性必修。数学教材是人教版一–九、人教 A 版（2019）必修两册和选择性必修三册；英语按人教 PEP（三年级起点，根据2022年版课程标准修订的新版）三上到六上（五下、六下新版未上线，暂按旧版）、人教版 Go for it! 新版七上到九上（九下新版未上线，暂按旧版九年级全一册第 9–14 单元等），以及人教版（2019）高中必修三册和选择性必修四册。初中物理按人教版新版（根据2022年版课程标准修订）八年级上册、八年级下册、九年级全一册，对齐《义务教育物理课程标准（2022年版2025年修订）》；高中物理按人教版（2019年审定）必修第一至三册和选择性必修第一至三册，对齐《普通高中物理课程标准（2017年版2020年修订）》。附**自适应前置诊断**与题库。数学答错会沿先修边从高中、初中一直回溯到具体的小学知识点。英语单独成图，不和数学连边；初中英语会连回小学英语，高中英语主要连回初中英语。物理也单独成图，用到的数学写在知识点的 `mathLinks` 字段里，不算先修边。仓库名仍是 `cn-math-taxonomy`。

**范围：数学高中做到必修和选择性必修，并且只用人民教育出版社 A 版（2019）；英语做到三年级到高中（人教版 2019 必修三册、选择性必修四册）。这是 AI 生成的初稿。** 7.3「复数的三角表示」仍按教材选学处理，没有单独建点。定积分不在选择性必修的内容要求里，没有建点。英语不出听力和口语题。

**反馈 / 挑错：** 题干、答案或先修关系有问题，或想提功能建议，请 [提交 Issue](https://github.com/xiaoyang111222/cn-math-taxonomy/issues/new/choose)（已提供「题目纠错」「功能建议」模板）。

> **状态声明：这是 AI 生成的初稿，未经任何教师审核。** 小学、初中、高中数学，以及小学、初中、高中英语都一样。
> 知识点的拆分粒度、掌握标准、诊断题答案，尤其是**先修关系（哪些是 hard、哪些是 soft，甚至某条边该不该存在）都需要一线教师审核**后才能用于教学、诊断或学习路径推荐。小学和初中数学的诊断题有自动核验，初中数学另有盲解复核，小学数学有独立程序复核；**高中题和英语题没有做盲解**，`verify` 和答案来自同一条表达式。小学册次目录、高中课标正文和高中章节目录多数不是官方逐页核对。英语课标正文、人教 PEP、Go for it! 和人教版（2019）高中英语的单元目录都没有逐页核对，标了「待核」的不要当成官方原文或页码。
>
> **册次标注：** 人教 A 版必修第二册通常在高一下学期讲授。本仓库为了把两册分成两个 `grade`，把必修第一册标成 10 / 高一，必修第二册标成 11 / 高二必修。选择性必修三册继续用 12 / 选必一、13 / 选必二、14 / 选必三，页面上不写成高三、高四。英语高中的 grade 10–12 是必修第一至三册，13–16 是选择性必修第一至四册，页面写成必修一至必修三、选必一至选必四，不写成高一到高四。这都不是教学进度的规定，待教师调整。

## 数据来源与对齐依据

- **课程标准**：教育部《义务教育数学课程标准（2022年版）》第一至第四学段（1—9 年级）的【内容要求】，以及《普通高中数学课程标准（2017年版2025年修订）》必修五个主题和选择性必修（函数、几何与代数、概率与统计、数学建模与数学探究）的公开转述。`data/cn-curriculum-standards.json` 现有 **314** 条（义务教育 234 + 高中必修 48 + 高中选择性必修 32）。小学部分于 2026-10-21 按《（2022年版2025年修订）》复核并补齐漏收条款（见 [docs/moe2025-alignment.md](docs/moe2025-alignment.md)），`source.revision*` 记录了现行版次与核对范围。第四学段条文仍是原先从教育部

Stream at the speed of the swarm.
Movies, shows, music, podcasts, audiobooks: any torrent starts in seconds and skips to any moment in under a second, straight from the swarm. No servers, no accounts, no limits.

torrentplayer.io · Why TorrentPlayer · Compare · Features · Performance · Privacy · Get it · Discord

--- TorrentPlayer is a free, open-source desktop app that **plays any torrent straight from BitTorrent**, video or audio, the way a streaming service would. Press play and it starts in seconds; drag the seek bar to minute 47 and it is playing minute 47 a moment later, long before the download gets there. No separate torrent client, no waiting for the file, no server in between. Use it for whatever you stream from torrents: films and series, music albums, podcasts, audiobooks, lectures, and open media. You are responsible for having the right to download and share what you play. ## Why TorrentPlayer - **Stream it. Skip it. Instantly.** Most torrent players download from the start and make you wait for the part you want. TorrentPlayer's own streaming engine fetches **the exact moment you jump to, first**, so skipping ahead resumes in under a second: 0.3 s on a fast link and 0.7 s (median) on a public swarm in our [measurements](#performance). Skip the intro, jump to the lecture's second half, scrub back and forth; it keeps up. - **Full speed, limited only by the swarm.** Video comes directly from the people sharing it. description: Desktop apps in Zig, with native UI drawn on the GPU or a web frontend
readme_excerpt:
nanoui

Desktop apps in Zig, with native UI drawn on the GPU or a web frontend.

Meet Nano. Transparent PNG · Original paper illustration

Want to see it in use? nanoterm is a terminal with a coding agent, and nanomon an activity monitor, both built on nanoui.

Get started · Native UI · Web pages · Testing · Platforms · Apps · Performance · Credits

Each window shows one of two kinds of interface: - **Native UI**, written in Zig alone and drawn by nanoui: no HTML, no JavaScript, no webview. It has flexbox layout, text in a glyph atlas, animations, and views you can test without a window. On macOS it draws with Metal and CoreText, in one instanced draw call per frame. - **A web page** in the system webview (WKWebView, macOS for now). The frontend calls Zig through a JavaScript client generated from your Zig types, with TypeScript declarations. Apps are single binaries. Nothing polls, so an idle app uses no CPU. ## Get started ```sh git clone --recursive https://github.com/justrach/nanoui cd nanoui zig build run-gallery # the native UI tour zig build run-hello # the webview example zig build test # unit and widget tests ``` You need Zig 0.17.0, plus the macOS SDK on a Mac (Xcode or the Command Line Tools). Linux apps need GTK 3 at run time and nothing at build time. `--recursive` also fetches the apps, which live in their own repositories as submodules under `apps/`. To fetch them after a plain clone, run `git submodule update --init`. ### A new app: `nui` `nui` makes an app that builds, and checks it without opening a window, for people and for coding agents alike. It never asks anything, and every command takes `--json`. ```sh nui start my-app # build.zig, a view, its test and an AGENTS.md; then it builds cd my-app nui test # the view's tests, rendered offscreen nui snapshot --out shot.png --script "click:Increment" # the app as a PNG, no window nui run # its window nui doctor # Zig 0.17, and GTK 3 on Linux ``` Each release has `nui` for macOS, Linux and Windows; `zig build nui` builds it into `zig-out/bin`. `nui start` pins nanoui at the release `nui` came with (`--nanoui REF` for another, `--local PATH` for a checkout).
